name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B NVFP4

attrs.author: NVIDIA
attrs.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal model built for long-running agents. It combines reasoning, instruction following, and tool use with text, image, document, and video understanding in a single model. It uses a hybrid Mamba-Transformer Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 120B total / 12B active parameters, plus Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for faster generation. Inputs: text, images, documents, and video. Output: text.
